notes: Sky view! On the Sky page Map tab, tap Sky view and point your phone at the sky: each plane your receiver hears is labelled on the camera picture - call sign, type, altitude and distance; tap one for the route and a photo. If the labels sit a little off, tap Line up, put a plane you can see in the circle and tap its label. Works at hub.motronimeadows.com (the camera needs the secure address).
